results.title: Chinese firms approach MITI over flying car testing in Malaysia
results.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Several Chinese companies have approached the Ministry of Investment, Trade and Industry (MITI) about using Malaysia as a testing ground for urban air mobility technologies, including so-called flying cars.
